hook: USA Today is suing OpenAI for over $250 million in damages.

sections.voiceover: USA Today is suing OpenAI for over $250 million in damages.
On October 8, 2026, the company filed a copyright complaint in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. What exactly triggered this massive claim?
Except the lawsuit covers hundreds of thousands of articles from 19 separate publications.

The complaint alleges that OpenAI used this material to train its large language models without authorization. Consequently, the company seeks more than $250 million to cover the intellectual property infringement. This filing remains active in the court system.
The case is registered under docket number 8892.
